Case study · DEVCON Pro Summit 2023 · Whitespace, Makati

Technology for Impact: the pro devs event of the year

Co-presented by Accenture, the 2023 Pro Summit gathered professional developers and tech leaders at Whitespace Makati for keynotes, panels, and a full expo floor, and reached half a million geeks online.

Summit in numbers

On site, online, and in the news

  • 500k+Geeks reached by the #DEVCONProSummit2023 campaign
  • 215k+Reached by the livestream and same-day-edit content
  • 250+Pro developers and tech leaders on site
  • 60+Media articles and creator features
  • 200+ professional developers
  • 50+ tech leaders
  • 20 exhibitors and event partners
  • 4.67 average rating
The experience

Keynotes, panels, and a full expo floor

Panels on closing the tech talent gap nationwide, open-source pandemic response solutions, and building technology for impact, plus hands-on booths from partners.
